response.overview: For 45-year-old artist Sarah, this is not a hypothetical issue. With her parents' 50th wedding anniversary approaching, they give her an ultimatum: she has one month to leave the family home. After a lifetime of being protected and supported by them, Sarah is suddenly expected to become independent. And there is one bizarre condition: if she ever wants to return, she must have a child to carry on the family line.
response.title: One Month
